title: SRE ops sync: triage + reliability prep (scratch)
content:
Context / purpose:
- Prep notes for weekly SRE ops sync (short standup + 25 min reliability review).
- Focus: SLO health, paging trends, top 3 incidents for last 14 days, and immediate follow-ups.

Quick snapshot (as of 2026-04-22 08:30 PT):
- API generate p95 latency (hosted-api): 420ms (target 350ms) -> regress of +20% week-over-week.
- Token pipeline error rate (5xx): 0.48% (SLO 0.5%) -> near breach but still within.
- Cold-starts causing tail latency on Dedicated pools: observed 3.1% of requests with >1s extra.
- Error budget burn (30d window): 12% consumed; pace suggests possible breach in ~7 weeks if trend continues.

Paging trend highlights:
- Total pages last 14 days: 27 (down from 34 previous 14d)
- Nighttime pages (00:00-06:00 PT): 11 (still high) -> majority are model OOM / CUDA OOMs on Dedicated pools.
- Route-level hotspots: /v1/generate A-region (us-west1) accounts for 44% of pages.
- Pager churn: several noisy alerts from xgpu-serving-timeout rule that needs tuning.

Top incidents to call out (short):
1) INC-4312: spike in 5xx on /v1/embeddings (2026-04-15)
   - Root cause: model variant mismatch during canary rollout + mem leak in plugin A.
   - Mitigation: reverted canary, OOM kill thresholds adjusted.
   - Follow-ups: plugin A patch + load test cadence.
2) INC-4278: Dedicated pool cold-start tail latency (2026-04-09)
   - Root cause: aggressive node scale-down during low demand leading to cold autostart.
   - Mitigation: increased min nodes for critical pools, added 3s warmup.
   - Follow-ups: autoscaler stability audit, revisit scale-down cooldown.
3) INC-4390: Intermittent tokenization errors (2026-04-20)
   - Root cause suspected buggy tokenizer config for new model family; low sample rate made detection slow.
   - Mitigation: blocklisted model version, forced fallback.
   - Follow-ups: add model validation in model onboarding pipeline.

Data / metrics to show in meeting (links):
- SLO dashboard (link): https://console.redwood.ai/dashboards/slo-summary
- Paging heatmap (last 14d): https://console.redwood.ai/dashboards/pager-heatmap
- Incident timeline: https://redwood.atlassian.net/secure/RapidBoard.jspa?projectKey=SRE

Agenda outline (15-20m):
- 0-3m quick wins + shoutouts (Marcus: cleanup of alert rules)
- 3-8m SLO snapshot + immediate risk (callout latency regression)
- 8-15m Deep dive: Dedicated pool cold-starts (summary + proposed changes)
- 15-20m Action items + owners + next steps

Talking points / suggested phrasing:
- "Latency p95 for generate is creeping up; main signal looks correlated with increased cold starts and a handful of backend retries."
- "We need a short-term throttle/route fallbacks for A-region until we address the cold-start instability."
- "Paging noise: propose reducing sensitivity on xgpu-serving-timeout for now and add a higher-fidelity rule that looks at error pattern + host count."

Triage checklist (for on-call):
- Confirm whether pages are client retries vs server errors. (quick grep on logs)
- Verify current autoscaler cooldowns for affected pools (config: infra/autoscaler-config).
- Identify any concurrent deploys during spike windows (check CI/CD deploy history).
- Check GPU memory trends per instance (Grafana: gpu/mem-usage).

Concrete follow-up action items (owner / ETA):
- A) Tune xgpu-serving-timeout alert thresholds to reduce noise (owner: Marcus Chen, ETA: 2026-04-24)
- B) Patch plugin A to fix mem leak + run targeted load test (owner: Elena Gomez, ETA: 2026-04-30)
- C) Add model validation step to onboarding to catch tokenizer misconfigs (owner: MLOps team - contact Rajiv, ETA: 2026-05-07)
- D) Increase min nodes for critical Dedicated pools and monitor tail latency for 7 days (owner: infra, contact: Priya Singh, ETA: 2026-04-25)
- E) Short-term route fallback: configure routing policy to fallback to lighter model family when p95 > 600ms (owner: product/hosting, contact: Ben K., ETA: 2026-04-26)

Open questions to bring to sync:
- Do we have appetite to accept slightly higher steady costs to reduce cold-starts (increase min nodes)? Pros/cons for Dev/Product?
- How aggressive do we want to be with alert dedup/aggregation to reduce pager fatigue?

Notes-to-self / follow-up items after meeting:
- Pull the detailed logs for two representative night-page incidents and annotate for postmortem.
- Draft updated alert rule proposal and circulate in #sre-ops for feedback.
- Schedule 30-minute follow-up with infra and product to finalize routing fallback params.

misc scratch items:
- Consider running a 48h synthetic load test focused on us-west1 region at 2x normal traffic (prepare a proposal + cost estimate).
- Quick wins: bump autoscaler cooldown to 4m, add mem reserve to Dedicated instance templates.

End of scratchpad.
